referenceSources.description:
This 1988 Renault 5 GT Turbo Group N rally car, chassis VF1C4050500958619, is presented exactly as it finished the 22nd Ivory Coast-Bandama Rally on November 1, 1990. Piloted by Alain Oreille and Michel Roissard, it won its Group N class and secured second place overall in the World Rally Championship event. The car’s blue Simon Racing livery, complete with “6875 SS 84” race plate and “Vive le sport” slogan, remains intact along with all original stickers and period sand in the cabin.

Equipped to FIA specifications, it features a Matter roll cage, bucket seats with harnesses, a spare wheel in the rear compartment, a tubular bumper, a ramp of four long-range driving lights, and dual searchlights beside the windshield. Recommissioned for a historic event with only essential fuel line replacements, this unmodified example retains its authentic rally setup. As a rare second-series R5 GT Turbo, it exemplifies Renault’s turbocharged 1397 cc performance heritage and the unique achievement of Oreille’s Group N success in WRC competition.
